position_end: In force: contributions payable in a single instalment by the last working day of June against audited accounts filed by 31 May; spending capped at 55% infrastructure expansion, 14% digital inclusion for vulnerable groups, 14% television broadcasting, 14% operating costs and 3% innovation; universal-access operators must charge 20% below the normal tariff; infrastructure built with fund money is state property with mandatory national roaming and contracts of ten years maximum; fines run to 114 minimum salaries, split 60% to the fund and 40% to the state budget.
